name: Single-bus single-breaker bay arrangement
summary: Connects the assigned circuit through its breaker to one common bus.
description: Connects the assigned circuit through its breaker to one common bus. A busbar arrangement defines the available paths between incoming circuits, outgoing circuits and bus sections. Its switching devices and measurement boundaries determine how a circuit can remain connected when part of the installation is unavailable.

In a switchyard, a single-line arrangement helps identify the bay connections, tie devices and possible alternate supply paths. Normal open points must remain separate from the equipment's physical ability to close. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Circuit feeder” at the input and “Single bus connection” at the output. A bus fault can affect multiple connected bays.
